answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 150491 Country: India Title: Can a boy be named ARHAM? Question: Can a boy be named ARHAM? Answer ID: 150491 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 734/557/D=8/1438) Someone may be named as Arham but it is better to name someone with the names in which the relation of slavery towards some attributes of Allah is found such as, Abdur Rahman, Abdur Rahim. It is also good to name after the names of the Companions, for example, Talha, Zubair, Khalid, Tayyib, etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
